name: White Ridge
description: Gull's village on the border of the Whispering Woods, destroyed in a wizards' duel.

description_citations.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian fights Towser in the destruction of White Ridge, then is pursued and subdued by the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: After fleeing White Ridge , she was pursued by Gull and Greensleeves and was subdued by the Stone Brain .

citation.text: "Mina", section "Dacian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A falling star presages disaster; White Ridge is destroyed in a wizards' duel, killing the elders and children.
timeline.quote: This is proven to be true when White Ridge is destroyed during a wizards ' duel .

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull finds stranded centaurs and a giant; Towser asks Gull to be his freight master and Gull accepts, confused by Towser's mind magic.
timeline.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepts his offer.

citation.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A shooting star falls in the woods near White Ridge, reputed to be a bad omen.
timeline.quote: a shooting star fell in the woods northwest of their village, which was reputed to be a bad omen

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Dim-witted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: White Ridge is destroyed during a wizards' duel, killing Greensleeves' parents and two of her siblings.
timeline.quote: many of the villagers were killed, including Greensleeves' parents and two of her siblings

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Dim-witted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser hires Gull as freightmaster and Gull brings Greensleeves along.
timeline.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepted his offer and brought Greensleeves along.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Dim-witted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: White Ridge is destroyed in a wizards' duel, killing Gull's parents and two siblings.
timeline.quote: many of the villagers were killed, including Gull's parents and two of his siblings

citation.text: "Gull", section "Whispering Woods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser asks Gull to become his freightmaster and Gull, confused by mind magic, accepts and brings Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepted his offer

citation.text: "Gull", section "Whispering Woods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Stone Brain falls near White Ridge and wizards converge on the village.
timeline.quote: In 4073 AR , the Stone Brain fell in the woods northwest of White Ridge .

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian and Towser duel and destroy White Ridge; Gull pledges to kill any wizard he meets.
timeline.quote: Gull the Woodcutter, one of the survivors, pledged an oath to kill any wizard he met.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An object falls in the Whispering Woods and Dacian and Towser meet to contend for it.
timeline.quote: the wizards Dacian and Towser met outside White Ridge to contend for it

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Each wizard summons armies and creatures to fight.
timeline.quote: Dacian summoned a phalanx of soldiers in silver-scaled armor.

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Overview". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The forces clash in the village, killing combatants and civilians, and an earthquake destroys nearly every cottage.
timeline.quote: Dacian summoned an earthquake that destroyed nearly every cottage in the village.

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Overview". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian drains survivors' life, Towser attacks with a stone rain, and survivors die of Black Plague.
timeline.quote: Dacian, flying above the scene, drained the life from the survivors

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Overview". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves refuse to leave; Sparrow Hawk has vanished.
timeline.quote: Their younger brother, Sparrow Hawk , had vanished in the destruction

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gull finds Helki, Holleb and Liko, who reveal they were controlled by wizards.
timeline.quote: wizards controlled them with mind magic, forcing them into battle against their will

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser arrives, offers Gull service, and releases the centaurs and Liko.
timeline.quote: offered Gull a place in his service

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: White Ridge is destroyed during a wizard's duel and Sparrow Hawk is separated from his family.
timeline.quote: Sparrow Hawk was separated from his family during the destruction of White Ridge

citation.text: "Sparrow Hawk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4073 AR Towser follows a falling object to the Whispering Woods, meets Dacian outside White Ridge, and their battle destroys the village.
timeline.quote: engaged in a battle that resulted in the village's destruction

citation.text: "Towser", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dacian and Towser destroy White Ridge in 4073 AR.
timeline.quote: until it was destroyed in 4073 AR by the wizards Dacian and Towser .

citation.text: "Whispering Woods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
